caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a pair of large calipers or tongs, rendered in shades of brown and rust. The tool is composed of two elongated, flat metal arms joined at a central pivot point. At one end of each arm are oval loops forming the handles, while the opposite ends curve outward and then inward, each finishing in pointed tips. The metal appears textured and worn, with variations in rust-brown color indicating aged or oxidized metal surface. The background is plain, light beige with minimal shading, providing contrast to the brown color of the tool, and there are no additional objects or decorations present within the composition.
title: Ice Tongs
